title: Event
description: The single envelope every input arrives in (contract.Event). Published to POST /v1/events. Replaying the same (source, id) must carry the same content.

source.description: Producer namespace, for example chat.im or task-manager.

employee.description: The employee whose loop receives the event. Producers that serve several employees (a shared Task Manager) must set it; a loop treats an empty value as addressed to itself and rejects another employee's event (unknown_employee).

type.description: Event type registered in the loop's catalog, for example message.addressed.

class.description: Filled from the catalog on admission; a mismatch is rejected.

mode.description: Filled from the catalog on admission; a mismatch is rejected.

refs.description: Correlation references: task, run, routine, reply_to, window, plan, ...

payload_schema.description: Names the schema of payload, for example taskmgr.execution/v1.
